# Security policy

Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability, leaked credential, or
private user data.

Report security issues privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/RATCHAW/vivace/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected component, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested
mitigation. Please allow a reasonable amount of time for investigation and a
fix before publishing details.

Only the latest version on the `main` branch receives security fixes.
